dialogue.text: That sound... It's hollow. All flash, no heart. Just like her.
Her? Don't know who you're on about. But my sound is fire! You look like one strong breeze away from becoming a puddle.
PJ, stop. Can't you feel it? The pain coming off her... it's overwhelming.
PAIN?! YOU DARE SPEAK TO ME OF PAIN?! I GAVE EVERYTHING TO CREATE PERFECTION, ONLY TO WATCH IT ROT INTO HATE!
This... this decay... this is the price of a mother's failure. A metamorphosis into grief itself.
A... mother's failure? I... I get that.
You get nothing. You were meant to be the moral compass, Super. Not a vessel for cheap sympathy.
